title: from a linked worktree the block goes to that worktree's AGENTS.md, not to the primary checkout
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). `AGENTS.md` is committed content of the branch you are on, so the file is written into the checkout of the working folder (the worktree), never into the primary.
